description: Site footer with brand, link columns and credits.

howToUse: Use it at the end of public pages: brand, link columns, credits and legal notes.
Give each column a title; each one becomes a navigation named by it. Links to other sites open in a new tab and show ↗.
Put language and color mode in `settings`.

keyboard.action: Moves through the links, column by column.

props.name: columns
props.description: Link columns, each with its own title and navigation.

props.name: credits
props.description: Credits on the left of the bottom line.

props.name: legal
props.description: Year, license or notice on the right of the bottom line.

props.name: layout
props.description: `columns` stacks the links under the title; `inline` puts brand and links in a single band, for sites with few links.

props.name: settings
props.description: Site preferences, such as language and color mode, aligned to the right below the links.

props.name: externalIcon
props.description: Shows ↗ after external links. Off when every link should read the same and the column title already names the destination.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.

examples.label: Playground
Four equal columns
examples.description: Four equal columns, title weight and link gap come from `--site-footer-columns`, `--site-footer-heading-weight` and `--site-footer-link-gap`.
